telegram_intake_outbox_lock_check.name: telegram_intake_outbox_lock_check
telegram_intake_outbox_lock_check.value: ("telegram_intake_outbox"."status" = 'PROCESSING') = ("telegram_intake_outbox"."locked_at" is not null and "telegram_intake_outbox"."locked_by" is not null)

signal_evidence_exactly_one_reference.name: signal_evidence_exactly_one_reference
signal_evidence_exactly_one_reference.value:
(
        (case when "signal_evidence"."market_observation_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end) +
        (case when "signal_evidence"."macro_observation_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end) +
        (case when "signal_evidence"."news_evidence_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
      ) = 1

signal_evidence_kind_matches_reference.name: signal_evidence_kind_matches_reference
signal_evidence_kind_matches_reference.value:
(
        ("signal_evidence"."evidence_kind" = 'market_observation' and "signal_evidence"."market_observation_id" is not null) or
        ("signal_evidence"."evidence_kind" = 'macro_observation' and "signal_evidence"."macro_observation_id" is not null) or
        ("signal_evidence"."evidence_kind" = 'news_evidence' and "signal_evidence"."news_evidence_id" is not null)
      )

risk_decisions_first_signal_unique.name: risk_decisions_first_signal_unique
risk_decisions_first_signal_unique.where: "risk_decisions"."supersedes_id" is null and "risk_decisions"."signal_id" is not null

risk_decisions_first_claim_unique.name: risk_decisions_first_claim_unique
risk_decisions_first_claim_unique.where: "risk_decisions"."supersedes_id" is null and "risk_decisions"."options_claim_id" is not null

risk_decisions_subject_check.name: risk_decisions_subject_check
risk_decisions_subject_check.value: ("risk_decisions"."signal_id" is not null) <> ("risk_decisions"."options_claim_id" is not null)

risk_decisions_legacy_null_check.name: risk_decisions_legacy_null_check
risk_decisions_legacy_null_check.value: "risk_decisions"."decision_id" is null and "risk_decisions"."approved" is null and "risk_decisions"."reasons" is null and "risk_decisions"."max_position_size" is null and "risk_decisions"."risk_per_trade" is null

risk_decisions_required_check.name: risk_decisions_required_check
risk_decisions_required_check.value: "risk_decisions"."stop_loss_validation_id" is not null and "risk_decisions"."decision_version" >= 1 and "risk_decisions"."status" is not null and "risk_decisions"."idempotency_key" is not null and "risk_decisions"."input_snapshot" is not null and "risk_decisions"."evidence_references" is not null and "risk_decisions"."decision_reason_code" is not null and "risk_decisions"."created_by" is not null and "risk_decisions"."instrument_type" is not null and "risk_decisions"."symbol" is not null

risk_decisions_numbers_check.name: risk_decisions_numbers_check
risk_decisions_numbers_check.value: ("risk_decisions"."entry_price" is null or "risk_decisions"."entry_price" > 0) and ("risk_decisions"."stop_loss" is null or "risk_decisions"."stop_loss" > 0) and ("risk_decisions"."target_1" is null or "risk_decisions"."target_1" > 0) and ("risk_decisions"."target_2" is null or "risk_decisions"."target_2" > 0) and ("risk_decisions"."target_3" is null or "risk_decisions"."target_3" > 0) and ("risk_decisions"."strike" is null or "risk_decisions"."strike" > 0) and ("risk_decisions"."planned_quantity" is null or "risk_decisions"."planned_quantity" >= 0) and ("risk_decisions"."planned_notional" is null or "risk_decisions"."planned_notional" >= 0) and ("risk_decisions"."planned_max_loss_amount" is null or "risk_decisions"."planned_max_loss_amount" >= 0) and ("risk_decisions"."planned_max_loss_percent" is null or "risk_decisions"."planned_max_loss_percent" >= 0) and ("risk_decisions"."planned_risk_reward_ratio" is null or "risk_decisions"."planned_risk_reward_ratio" >= 0) and ("risk_decisions"."confidence_score" is null or ("risk_decisions"."confidence_score" >= 0 and "risk_decisions"."confidence_score" <= 100))

risk_decisions_review_shape_check.name: risk_decisions_review_shape_check
risk_decisions_review_shape_check.value: "risk_decisions"."status" <> 'APPROVED_FOR_REVIEW' or ("risk_decisions"."stop_loss" is not null and "risk_decisions"."entry_price" is not null and "risk_decisions"."stop_loss_basis" is not null)

risk_decisions_sized_review_check.name: risk_decisions_sized_review_check
risk_decisions_sized_review_check.value: "risk_decisions"."status" <> 'APPROVED_FOR_REVIEW' or (coalesce("risk_decisions"."planned_quantity" > 0, false) and coalesce("risk_decisions"."planned_notional" > 0, false) and coalesce("risk_decisions"."planned_max_loss_amount" > 0, false) and coalesce("risk_decisions"."planned_max_loss_percent" > 0, false) and coalesce("risk_decisions"."output_snapshot" -> 'sizing' ->> 'status' = 'SIZED', false))

stop_loss_validations_subject_check.name: stop_loss_validations_subject_check
stop_loss_validations_subject_check.value: ("stop_loss_validations"."subject_kind" = 'signal' and "stop_loss_validations"."signal_id" is not null and "stop_loss_validations"."options_claim_id" is null) or ("stop_loss_validations"."subject_kind" = 'options_claim' and "stop_loss_validations"."options_claim_id" is not null and "stop_loss_validations"."signal_id" is null)

stop_loss_validations_valid_shape_check.name: stop_loss_validations_valid_shape_check
stop_loss_validations_valid_shape_check.value: "stop_loss_validations"."result" <> 'VALID' or ("stop_loss_validations"."normalized_stop_loss" is not null and "stop_loss_validations"."normalized_stop_loss" > 0 and "stop_loss_validations"."entry_price" is not null and "stop_loss_validations"."entry_price" > 0 and "stop_loss_validations"."risk_distance" > 0)

circuit_breaker_events_reset_shape_check.name: circuit_breaker_events_reset_shape_check
circuit_breaker_events_reset_shape_check.value: ("circuit_breaker_events"."event_type" = 'RESET') = ("circuit_breaker_events"."breach_event_id" is not null) and ("circuit_breaker_events"."event_type" = 'RESET') = ("circuit_breaker_events"."reset_authorization" is not null)

risk_approval_cards_shape_check.name: risk_approval_cards_shape_check
risk_approval_cards_shape_check.value: "risk_approval_cards"."nonce" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' and "risk_approval_cards"."card_content_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and length("risk_approval_cards"."card_text") between 1 and 3800 and ("risk_approval_cards"."card_text_sha256" is null or "risk_approval_cards"."card_text_sha256" = "risk_approval_cards"."card_content_sha256")

risk_approvals_reject_reason_check.name: risk_approvals_reject_reason_check
risk_approvals_reject_reason_check.value: "risk_approvals"."action" <> 'REJECT' or ("risk_approvals"."reason" is not null and length(btrim("risk_approvals"."reason")) > 0)

historical_normalized_records_market_che.name: historical_normalized_records_market_check
historical_normalized_records_market_che.value: ("historical_normalized_records"."market" is null) = ("historical_normalized_records"."market_source" is null) and ("historical_normalized_records"."market_source" is null or "historical_normalized_records"."market_source" in ('record', 'batch_default', 'underlying_mapping'))

historical_normalized_records_numbers_ch.name: historical_normalized_records_numbers_check
historical_normalized_records_numbers_ch.value: ("historical_normalized_records"."strike" is null or "historical_normalized_records"."strike" > 0) and ("historical_normalized_records"."stop_loss" is null or "historical_normalized_records"."stop_loss" > 0)

historical_evaluation_runs_scope_check.name: historical_evaluation_runs_scope_check
historical_evaluation_runs_scope_check.value: ("historical_evaluation_runs"."scope" = 'BATCH' and "historical_evaluation_runs"."import_batch_id" is not null and "historical_evaluation_runs"."normalized_record_id" is null) or ("historical_evaluation_runs"."scope" = 'RECORD' and "historical_evaluation_runs"."normalized_record_id" is not null and "historical_evaluation_runs"."import_batch_id" is null)

historical_outcome_labels_reason_check.name: historical_outcome_labels_reason_check
historical_outcome_labels_reason_check.value: ("historical_outcome_labels"."final_outcome" not in ('INVALID_SIGNAL', 'UNVERIFIABLE') or "historical_outcome_labels"."primary_reason" is not null) and ("historical_outcome_labels"."primary_reason" is null or "historical_outcome_labels"."primary_reason" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,60}$')

historical_source_registry_type_check.name: historical_source_registry_type_check
historical_source_registry_type_check.value: ("historical_source_registry"."entry_type" = 'IDENTITY' and "historical_source_registry"."alias_of_id" is null) or ("historical_source_registry"."entry_type" = 'ALIAS_LINK' and "historical_source_registry"."alias_of_id" is not null and "historical_source_registry"."alias_of_id" <> "historical_source_registry"."id")

historical_source_registry_value_check.name: historical_source_registry_value_check
historical_source_registry_value_check.value: "historical_source_registry"."source_key" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and char_length("historical_source_registry"."channel_label") between 1 and 200 and ("historical_source_registry"."reason" is null or char_length("historical_source_registry"."reason") <= 500)

historical_trust_tiers_tier_check.name: historical_trust_tiers_tier_check
historical_trust_tiers_tier_check.value: ("historical_trust_tiers"."tier" = 'A' and "historical_trust_tiers"."tier_label" = 'HIGH_TRUST') or ("historical_trust_tiers"."tier" = 'B' and "historical_trust_tiers"."tier_label" = 'MODERATE_TRUST') or ("historical_trust_tiers"."tier" = 'C' and "historical_trust_tiers"."tier_label" = 'LOW_TRUST') or ("historical_trust_tiers"."tier" = 'D' and "historical_trust_tiers"."tier_label" = 'UNTRUSTED') or ("historical_trust_tiers"."tier" = 'UNKNOWN' and "historical_trust_tiers"."tier_label" = 'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE')

historical_confidence_estimates_tier_che.name: historical_confidence_estimates_tier_check
historical_confidence_estimates_tier_che.value: "historical_confidence_estimates"."tier" in ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW', 'UNKNOWN') and "historical_confidence_estimates"."score" between 0 and 100 and (("historical_confidence_estimates"."tier" = 'UNKNOWN') = ("historical_confidence_estimates"."score" = 0)) and "historical_confidence_estimates"."sample_size" >= 0

historical_confidence_runs_scope_check.name: historical_confidence_runs_scope_check
historical_confidence_runs_scope_check.value: (("historical_confidence_runs"."scope" = 'BATCH' and "historical_confidence_runs"."import_batch_id" is not null and "historical_confidence_runs"."normalized_record_id" is null) or ("historical_confidence_runs"."scope" = 'RECORD' and "historical_confidence_runs"."normalized_record_id" is not null and "historical_confidence_runs"."import_batch_id" is null)) and "historical_confidence_runs"."trust_mode" in ('point_in_time', 'latest')

historical_pattern_definitions_level_che.name: historical_pattern_definitions_level_check
historical_pattern_definitions_level_che.value: "historical_pattern_definitions"."pattern_key" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "historical_pattern_definitions"."level" between 1 and 4 and char_length("historical_pattern_definitions"."key_text") between 1 and 400

agent_evidence_references_value_check.name: agent_evidence_references_value_check
agent_evidence_references_value_check.value: "agent_evidence_references"."kind" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,30}$' and "agent_evidence_references"."ref" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:/#@=-]{1,200}$' and ("agent_evidence_references"."ref_sha256" is null or "agent_evidence_references"."ref_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and "agent_evidence_references"."ordinal" >= 0

agent_findings_value_check.name: agent_findings_value_check
agent_findings_value_check.value: "agent_findings"."code" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,60}$' and "agent_findings"."severity" in ('INFO', 'LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL') and char_length("agent_findings"."summary") <= 300 and "agent_findings"."ordinal" >= 0 and octet_length("agent_findings"."detail"::text) <= 2048

agent_orchestrator_runs_value_check.name: agent_orchestrator_runs_value_check
agent_orchestrator_runs_value_check.value: "agent_orchestrator_runs"."run_key" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "agent_orchestrator_runs"."config_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "agent_orchestrator_runs"."input_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "agent_orchestrator_runs"."status" in ('COMPLETED', 'INCOMPLETE', 'FAILED') and "agent_orchestrator_runs"."trigger" in ('WORKER_PIPELINE', 'OPERATOR') and "agent_orchestrator_runs"."duration_ms" >= 0 and "agent_orchestrator_runs"."completed_at" >= "agent_orchestrator_runs"."started_at" and "agent_orchestrator_runs"."decision_version" >= 1

agent_orchestrator_syntheses_value_check.name: agent_orchestrator_syntheses_value_check
agent_orchestrator_syntheses_value_check.value: "agent_orchestrator_syntheses"."assessment" in ('RESEARCH_SUPPORTIVE', 'RESEARCH_NEUTRAL', 'RESEARCH_CAUTION', 'RESEARCH_ADVERSE', 'RESEARCH_BLOCKED', 'RESEARCH_INCOMPLETE') and "agent_orchestrator_syntheses"."synthesis_input_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and ("agent_orchestrator_syntheses"."score" is null or "agent_orchestrator_syntheses"."score" between -1 and 1) and octet_length("agent_orchestrator_syntheses"."synthesis_input"::text) <= 32768 and octet_length("agent_orchestrator_syntheses"."result"::text) <= 32768

agent_runs_status_check.name: agent_runs_status_check
agent_runs_status_check.value: "agent_runs"."status" in ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'TIMEOUT', 'SKIPPED', 'UNAVAILABLE') and "agent_runs"."verdict" in ('SUPPORTIVE', 'NEUTRAL', 'CAUTION', 'ADVERSE', 'BLOCKING', 'UNAVAILABLE') and "agent_runs"."attempts" between 0 and 5 and "agent_runs"."duration_ms" >= 0 and "agent_runs"."completed_at" >= "agent_runs"."started_at"

agent_runs_coherence_check.name: agent_runs_coherence_check
agent_runs_coherence_check.value: (("agent_runs"."status" = 'COMPLETED') = ("agent_runs"."verdict" <> 'UNAVAILABLE')) and (("agent_runs"."status" = 'COMPLETED') = ("agent_runs"."confidence" is not null)) and ("agent_runs"."confidence" is null or "agent_runs"."confidence" between 0 and 100) and ("agent_runs"."status" in ('COMPLETED', 'UNAVAILABLE') or "agent_runs"."error_code" is not null)

agent_runs_value_check.name: agent_runs_value_check
agent_runs_value_check.value: "agent_runs"."agent_id" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{2,40}$' and "agent_runs"."input_snapshot_ref" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and ("agent_runs"."error_code" is null or "agent_runs"."error_code" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,60}$') and ("agent_runs"."error_message" is null or char_length("agent_runs"."error_message") <= 300) and octet_length("agent_runs"."input_snapshot"::text) <= 65536 and octet_length("agent_runs"."output_snapshot"::text) <= 16384
